newsitem.title: KUWAIT: KPI to hike Belgium lubricants plant output - KPC.
newsitem.headline: KPI to hike Belgium lubricants plant output - KPC.

text.p: State-owned Kuwait Petroleum International Ltd (KPI) plans to raise the output of a Belgium-based lubricants plant to 105,500 tonnes per year from 42,000 tonnes, a Kuwait Petroleum Corp (KPC) official said on Thursday.

The expansion, which will cost about $10 million, is designed to boost the plant's output to provide Texaco Inc with 63,500 tonnes of lubricants per year under a recent deal with KPI, the official said.
The plan also involves expanding the storage capacity of the plant, he said.
London-based KPI is a fully-owned subsidiary of the state-owned KPC which runs the Gulf Arab state's oil industry.
